set.body: Add typed per-family requests and explicit JVM interpreters: generic FSL XML offset-aware loader then Harvard-Oxford/Julich, HCPex, Olsen MTL/hippocampal and selected TemplateFlow subcortical families (CIT168, HCP thalamus, MDTB10, HCP hippocampus/amygdala). Anatomical visual-cortex datasets remain in scope; rendering is excluded. Pin immutable asset specifications and expected digests; discovery describes executable requests honestly. Acceptance per family: offline parser fixtures, canonical identity/coverage/provenance, checked failures, JVM loading evidence and JS descriptor tests. Split into family issues before implementation rather than one broad simultaneous port.
set.title: Atlas: add pinned FSL, HCPex, subcortical and MTL loading families
